newsitem.title: UK: Unisys says Varig Cargo uses VIS.
newsitem.headline: Unisys says Varig Cargo uses VIS.

text.p: Unisys Corp said Brazil's Varig Airlines has ordered a Unisys Virtual Integrator Suite (VIS) to increase its air cargo competitiveness and improve its service to shippers.

Unisys said in a statement released here that under the 10-year, $52 million contract, Varig will initially use the first level of the computer system to improve cargo business functionality on a hosted basis from the Unisys Infohub, the latter's global information hub in Eagan, Minnesota.
It added that Varig also intends to acquire the next two levels of VIS, which will enable Varig to offer 48-hour global delivery with 95 percent reliability.
It will also offer a full product portfolio of competitive services to shippers, including the one-stop shopping now available from integrators.
Varig began implementation of the first level of VIS in November and this is expected to be completed within the next six months, the statement added.
